title: af.perf-profiles/5
description: One diagnostic child run, profiles.json (ADR-0174): its link to the parent comparison, which never changes that verdict; the automatic or explicit selection; sources, diagnostic recipe and builds; budgets and their use; the explicit execution mode, its containment and, contained, its container and verified scratch bound (ADR-0176); every tool's identity or why it is unavailable; each CPU capture of a probe region or a CLI process with its region, event, unwinder, effective frequency, samples, losses, unknown frames and symbols; baseline, candidate and both-direction difference flamegraphs, original and sanitized; phase traces with their region's coverage and measured overhead; counters as explanatory proxies; and every omission with its reason and reproduction.

decimal.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal, at most 38 significant digits.

rational.description: Exact signed rational in lowest terms, such as -3/4 or 2.
